js: localStorage.removeItem('kahneman.group'); localStorage.removeItem('kahneman.guess'); window.__until = function(c){ return new Promise(function(r){ var t = Date.now(); (function p(){ try { if (c()) { r(true); return; } } catch (e) {} if (Date.now() - t > 10000) { r(false); return; } setTimeout(p, 100); })(); }); }

name: svg-loaded
js: __until(function(){ const i = document.querySelector('#panel .kahneman .trick img'); return i.complete && i.naturalWidth > 0; })

name: reveal-numbers-match-api
js: fetch('/api/anchor/stats').then(r=>r.json()).then(s=>__until(function(){ const f=v=>Number.isInteger(v)?String(v):v.toFixed(1); const t=[...document.querySelectorAll('#panel .kahneman .num')].map(e=>e.textContent); return t[0]===f(s.A.mean) && t[1]===f(s.B.mean) && t[2]==='78'; }))

name: counts-shown
js: fetch('/api/anchor/stats').then(r=>r.json()).then(s=>{ const t=[...document.querySelectorAll('#panel .kahneman .col .n')].map(e=>e.textContent); return t[0]===`from ${s.A.n} people` && t[1]===`from ${s.B.n} people` && t[2]==='1869 to 1948'; })

name: own-guess-highlighted
js: __until(function(){ const g=localStorage.getItem('kahneman.group'); const cols=[...document.querySelectorAll('#panel .kahneman .col')]; const mine=cols[g==='A'?0:1]; return mine.classList.contains('mine') && mine.classList.contains('lit') && mine.querySelector('.you').textContent==='you said 60' && cols.filter(c=>c.classList.contains('mine')).length===1; })

name: explain-and-close-verbatim
js: document.querySelector('#panel .kahneman .explain').textContent === "The first number was random and obviously wrong. It still pulled your guess toward it. That's anchoring: the mind starts from whatever it was handed and doesn't adjust far enough." && document.querySelector('#panel .kahneman .closing').textContent === 'Like squares A and B: you can know the number is irrelevant and still be moved by it.'
